bridge/types/AuthoritySetCommitment.title: AuthoritySetCommitment
bridge/types/AuthoritySetCommitment.description: A committee commitment: `validator_set_id` (u64), total `seat_count` (u32), and the keccak256 root over the deduplicated authority leaves.

bridge/types/BeefyConsensusState.title: BeefyConsensusState
bridge/types/BeefyConsensusState.description: The light-client datum: the latest verified root and height plus the current and successor committees.

bridge/types/BeefyMmrLeaf.title: BeefyMmrLeaf
bridge/types/BeefyMmrLeaf.description: The `pallet-beefy-mmr` leaf of a block; `extra` is empty in version 0.

bridge/types/BeefyThreshold.title: BeefyThreshold
bridge/types/BeefyThreshold.description: The threshold datum: the quorum ratio and the funded-update fee cap (`base + per_signer × signers`, lovelace).

bridge/types/BridgeUpdate.title: BridgeUpdate
bridge/types/BridgeUpdate.description: The `committee_bridge_logic` redeemer: a signed root, one signature per multiproof leaf in tree order (64 bytes, or empty for a non-signer), the leaf of `block_number`, and its proofs.

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

cnight_generates_dust/DustMappingDatum.title: DustMappingDatum
cnight_generates_dust/DustMappingDatum.description: Links a Cardano wallet credential to a Midnight dust address.

forever/types_v2/FederatedOpsV2.title: FederatedOpsV2
forever/types_v2/FederatedOpsV2.description:
FederatedOpsV2 adds a `message` field compared to FederatedOps v1.
 Used after migration from v1 datum. Expects logic_round: 2.

rewards/types/AccountAction.title: AccountAction
rewards/types/AccountAction.description:
Withdraw redeemer: one kind of user action, applied to every account-address
 input; outputs from `offset` match those inputs 1:1 in ledger order.

rewards/types/AccountDatum.title: AccountDatum
rewards/types/AccountDatum.description:
One datum per list NFT: head `""`, deposit `0x00 ++ skh`, registration `0x01 ++ skh`, tail `0x00 ++ tail_key`.
 `destinations`: `kind_byte ++ address -> weight`; weights > 0 and sum to 1000. `operator_keys`: opaque, node-owned.
 `payout_threshold`: STAR above the distribution fee at which Midnight puts the account in a tree; ≥ 0.

rewards/types/AccountGate.title: AccountGate
rewards/types/AccountGate.description: Spend and mint redeemer: which withdrawal validates this UTXO.

rewards/types/BatcherRedeemer.title: BatcherRedeemer
rewards/types/BatcherRedeemer.description: `LoadAndPay` opens an epoch with its first batch; `Pay` continues it.

rewards/types/BatcherState.title: BatcherState
rewards/types/BatcherState.description:
Inline datum on the batcher state NFT UTXO. `cursor` is the next key to
 pay; `start_key` is the first key paid in the epoch. Both are read only
 while `complete == False`. `treasury_total` is the loaded epoch's
 Treasury share, paid to the ICS by the batch that completes the fold.

rewards/types/DigestProof.title: DigestProof
rewards/types/DigestProof.description:
MMR proof of a BEEFY leaf, the SCALE header it commits to, and the
 `extrinsics_root` trie proof of the rewards extrinsic in that block. The
 leaf index is the leaf's `parent_number`; the leaf count is the bridge's
 `latest_height` (bridge spec §13).

rewards/types/ExitInfo.title: ExitInfo
rewards/types/ExitInfo.description: Predecessor input and output indices for one exiting leaf.

rewards/types/PayPair.title: PayPair
rewards/types/PayPair.description: Deposit input and output indices for one paid leaf; for an exit the output is the refund.

rewards/types/ReleaseState.title: ReleaseState
rewards/types/ReleaseState.description: Inline datum on the reserve forever NFT UTXO after the first release; before it the NFT holds the deploy datum `Constr 0 [0, 0]`.

rewards/types/StagingStateV2.title: StagingStateV2
rewards/types/StagingStateV2.description: Staging-track hashes read from the reserve logic v2 NFT input: `StagingState` plus the staging pool forever.
